name: Elin Karlsson
bio:
Elin's path to motorsport security was unconventional. A competitive fencer in her youth, she developed an acute sense of spatial awareness and risk assessment, skills she realized were highly transferable. After a brief stint in private security, she leveraged her technical aptitude and analytical skills to land a role at Cavaleiro Sports. 

She approaches security with a data-driven mindset, meticulously analyzing potential threats and implementing proactive measures. Elin is known for her unwavering dedication to maintaining a secure environment, ensuring the team can focus on performance without distraction. Her calm demeanor under pressure allows her to effectively manage crises, earning her the respect of her colleagues. 

What sets Elin apart is her ability to anticipate potential security breaches, rather than simply reacting to them. She's constantly learning and adapting, making her a valuable asset to Cavaleiro Sports.

physical.hairStyle: Sleek, high ponytail with precise parting.
physical.description: Elin is a lean woman, usually wearing practical, dark-colored attire, with sharp, observant eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on using military time, even in casual conversation.
